proposals.evidence: Turner records Nepali biyāna, eastern bihān and Western Pahari bhɛṇi daybreak under the vibhāna family. The Danuwar/Tharu survey bin-/bhin- morning forms match this reduced regional stem with local endings. The dictionary’s alternative formation through vibhāyana is retained as unresolved within the family.
